remarks: A rare blend of privacy, luxury and modern design, this stunningly renovated 5-bed, 5-bath Colonial is set on 4 private acres with a heated pool. Spanning over 8,000 SF across three light-filled levels, the home offers exceptional living and entertaining spaces. Primary suite features vaulted ceiling and dual dressing rooms, while a dramatic family room showcases soaring ceiling and three walls of windows. The new chef's kitchen boasts a large island, Sub-Zero appliances, butler's pantry with wine fridge and custom cabinetry. Multiple gathering spaces incl formal living and dining rooms plus family rooms on 2nd floor and walk-out LL. Outdoor living is enhanced by a spacious terrace with kitchen overlooking the pool + landscaped grounds. Additional amenities include exercise room, mudroom, 2 laundries, 400 amp service + a 3 car garage.
